SELECT
  calendar_year,
  SUM(value) FILTER (WHERE ticker = 'INTC') AS company_revenue,
  SUM(value) AS total_market_revenue,
  (SUM(value) FILTER (WHERE ticker = 'INTC')::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(value),0)::numeric) AS market_share
FROM comp_financials
WHERE metric = 'Revenue'
  AND ticker IN ('NVDA','AMD','INTC','MU','QCOM','AVGO','TXN')
  AND calendar_quarter_num IS NOT NULL
  AND calendar_year >= (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)::int - 5)
GROUP BY calendar_year
ORDER BY calendar_year DESC
LIMIT 10000;

details.sql:
SELECT
  calendar_year,
  SUM(value) FILTER (WHERE ticker = 'INTC') AS company_revenue,
  SUM(value) AS total_market_revenue,
  (SUM(value) FILTER (WHERE ticker = 'INTC')::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(value),0)::numeric) AS market_share
FROM comp_financials
WHERE metric = 'Revenue'
  AND ticker IN ('NVDA','AMD','INTC','MU','QCOM','AVGO','TXN')
  AND calendar_quarter_num IS NOT NULL
  AND calendar_year >= (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)::int - 5)
GROUP BY calendar_year
ORDER BY calendar_year DESC
LIMIT 10000;
